name: Kaufland Marketplace
description: Kaufland Marketplace (formerly real.de) seller API: orders and their units, storefronts, units, customer service tickets with their messages, returns and return units, warehouses, and tracking numbers for sent units. Answer tickets and add shipments. HMAC-signed requests: the signature covers the method, URL, body and a timestamp.
instructions:
**Getting credentials**
1. You must already be a Kaufland Marketplace seller. In the **Seller Portal** open **Settings → API keys** and create a key pair.
2. You receive a **Client Key** (public, identifies you) and a **Secret Key** (never sent — it signs the request). Set `KAUFLAND_CLIENT_KEY` and `KAUFLAND_SECRET_KEY`.

**The secret never travels.** Kaufland does not accept a bearer token: every request carries `Shop-Client-Key`, `Shop-Timestamp` and `Shop-Signature`, where the signature is an HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical string

```
<METHOD>\n<FULL URL INCLUDING QUERY>\n<BODY>\n<UNIX TIMESTAMP>
```

keyed with the secret, with no newline after the timestamp. AnythingMCP computes it per request and sends the timestamp it used, so the server can recompute the same string.

**A signature is only valid for a few minutes.** Kaufland rejects a request whose timestamp has drifted, which means a 401 here can be a clock problem rather than a key problem. If every call fails and the keys are definitely right, check the host's time.

**Storefronts are per country.** Kaufland runs a storefront per country (`de`, `cz`, `sk`, `pl`, `at` and more); `kaufland_list_storefronts` returns the current list. Most endpoints take a `storefront` parameter. Omitting it gives you the seller's default, which is rarely what a report about one market wants.

**Orders page with offset and limit**, and `ts_created_from` / `ts_created_to` bound the window — both ISO 8601. Ask for the window you mean; the default is short.

**Shipments** have no list endpoint in the Seller API: for an order's delivery details call `kaufland_get_order` with `embedded=delivery`. `kaufland_add_tracking_to_order_unit` adds a carrier code and tracking number to a unit that is already marked as sent.

**Tickets**: `kaufland_list_tickets` lists them, `kaufland_get_ticket_details` (with `embedded=messages`) shows one with its conversation, `kaufland_list_ticket_messages` the newest messages across tickets. `kaufland_add_ticket_message` answers the buyer in the ticket.

**Returns**: `kaufland_search_returns` lists returns (one parcel each), `kaufland_get_return_details` shows its return units with the reason, `kaufland_list_return_units` lists the returned items, e.g. those with status `return_arrived` that wait for a decision.

**Writes**: the ticket answer reaches the buyer and the tracking number is shown to them. Show the user exactly what will be sent and wait for confirmation before either call.

**Order units are where the money is.** An order carries `order_units`, each with its own status, price and fulfilment state. A part-cancelled order is normal, so a revenue figure should sum the units that were actually fulfilled rather than the order total.

**Cloud reachability**: sellerapi.kaufland.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: kaufland_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the seller's warehouses with their id, name and address. No parameters — the lightest call, and the quickest proof that the key pair and the host clock both line up.

tools.name: kaufland_list_orders
tools.description: List orders in a time window: id, storefront, creation time and number of units. Call kaufland_get_order for the buyer, the addresses and the units. Bound the window explicitly: the default is short and a report that silently used it will understate the period.

storefront.description: Storefront code, e.g. de. kaufland_list_storefronts lists them.

tools.name: kaufland_get_order
tools.description: Read one order in full: the buyer, the billing and shipping address and every order unit with its own price, status and delivery window.

embedded.description: One extra object to include: order_invoices, delivery or kss_delivery. Order units are always included.

tools.name: kaufland_list_order_units
tools.description: List individual order units — the level Kaufland actually fulfils, cancels and pays out at. A part-cancelled order is normal, so revenue should be summed here rather than from the order total.

storefront.description: Storefront code, e.g. de. kaufland_list_storefronts lists them.

status.description: Unit status, e.g. open, sent, cancelled, returned.

tools.name: kaufland_list_units
tools.description: List the seller's units (offers) with their EAN, condition, price, stock and the storefront each is listed on.

storefront.description: Storefront code, e.g. de. kaufland_list_storefronts lists them.

tools.name: kaufland_list_tickets
tools.description: List customer service tickets with their subject, status and the order they relate to — where a buyer complaint shows up before it becomes a rating.

storefront.description: Storefront code, e.g. de. kaufland_list_storefronts lists them.

tools.name: kaufland_get_ticket_details
tools.description: Read one customer service ticket: status, open reason (product_not_as_described, product_defect, product_not_delivered, product_return, contact_other), whether the seller has to act, the order unit ids and dates. embedded adds messages (the conversation), order_units, product, buyer or files. Use it before answering with kaufland_add_ticket_message.

tools.name: kaufland_list_ticket_messages
tools.description: List the latest ticket messages across all tickets: ticket id, author role (seller, buyer, system, customer_service) and name, text and time. Filter by creation time to see what came in since a moment; for one ticket use kaufland_get_ticket_details.

ts_created_from_iso.description: Only messages created after this time, ISO 8601.

tools.name: kaufland_search_returns
tools.description: List returns (Retouren): return id, storefront, status (return_requested, label_generated, package_sent, package_received, label_deleted), return carrier and tracking code, fulfilment type and dates. Filter by storefront, status, tracking code or creation and update time. kaufland_get_return_details gives the units and reasons of one return.

storefront.description: Storefront code, e.g. de. kaufland_list_storefronts lists them.

ts_created_from_iso.description: Only returns created after this time, YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

ts_updated_from_iso.description: Only returns updated after this time, YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

tracking_code.description: Tracking code of the return parcel.

sort.description: Newest created (default) or newest updated first.

tools.name: kaufland_get_return_details
tools.description: Read one return: status, carrier and tracking code, and its return units with the order unit each belongs to, unit status (need_to_be_returned, return_arrived, return_accepted, return_rejected, return_in_clarification and others), the buyer's reason and note. embedded can add the buyer.

tools.name: kaufland_list_return_units
tools.description: List return units, the returned items one by one: return unit id, return id, order unit id, status, reason and note. Filter by storefront, status (e.g. return_arrived for parcels waiting for a decision) or creation time.

storefront.description: Storefront code, e.g. de. kaufland_list_storefronts lists them.

ts_created_from_iso.description: Only units created after this time, YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

tools.name: kaufland_add_ticket_message
tools.description: Answer a customer service ticket: the text is sent to the buyer (and Kaufland customer service) in the ticket conversation. Read the ticket with kaufland_get_ticket_details first, show the user the exact text and ask for confirmation before calling.

text.description: Message text shown to the buyer, in the storefront language.

tools.name: kaufland_add_tracking_to_order_unit
tools.description: Add a shipment (carrier code and tracking number) to an order unit that is already marked as sent, so the buyer can follow the parcel. carrier_code must be one of the carrier codes in the Kaufland Seller API documentation. Show the user the unit and tracking number and ask for confirmation before calling.

id_order_unit.description: Order unit id from kaufland_get_order or kaufland_list_order_units.

carrier_code.description: Carrier code from the Kaufland Seller API documentation.

tools.name: kaufland_list_storefronts
tools.description: List the storefronts (one per country) Kaufland runs, with the currency and locale of each. Use it to find the storefront code the other tools need.
